header: Features, each with its current status
lead: Shipped, in progress or planned, shown as a list. Use it for a public roadmap; use the included checklist when the status is only yes or no.
note: The note holds the caveat about target dates and commitments.

items.title: Editors write the status word
items.text: It appears as a badge and can be in any language.

items.title: The dot follows a switch
items.text: The colour comes from a switch, not from the text, so it never contradicts the word.

items.title: Unshipped rows are dimmed
items.text: Their titles use the secondary colour, so readers notice shipped features first.
